passage: A bakery began listing the nutritional content of every loaf it sells. Afterward, sales of its whole-wheat bread rose sharply, while sales of its other breads stayed the same. One explanation for this pattern is that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: some customers chose whole-wheat bread after learning about its nutritional content.
the bakery stopped selling most of its other breads once it added the new labels.
customers bought less bread overall because the labels made bread seem unhealthy.
whole-wheat bread became cheaper than the other breads after the labels appeared.
steps: The change: nutrition labels were added.
The result: only whole-wheat sales rose.
A plausible link: the labels made whole-wheat bread's nutrition visible, and some customers chose it.
Other breads' sales stayed the same (so they weren't dropped), total sales rose (not fell), and price is never mentioned.
key: Connect the change described to the specific result, without adding outside information.
